description: Read this before making a multiplayer game. Press5 Play gives launch pad games free multiplayer: matchmaking, room codes, shared state, host handoff and reconnects, with no server code to write. Returns the guide (SDK API, press5.game.json, patterns for real-time, turn-based and party games, limits) and the multiplayer starter templates (mp-brawl, mp-duel, mp-party, mp-sketch, mp-arena). No account needed.
name: multiplayer_guide
title: How to make a multiplayer game
